dedupe_keys.name: digital twin platform for water treatment plants with a microservices architecture ayesa and unir

description: This record covers a framework for a digital twin platform for a wastewater treatment plant, described in a 2024 Sensors paper by Rodríguez-Alonso, Pena-Regueiro and García of the Spanish engineering firm Ayesa and the University of La Rioja. The platform is built on a microservices architecture designed for edge computing, and aims to optimise operation and maintenance of the plant's systems by combining machine learning, process modelling and simulation, and information from BIM models to support decisions. Keywords include HMI, artificial intelligence and edge computing. Coverage: a design framework for one class of facility, with the abstract and introduction read here. Access: free paper; the code and platform are not stated to be released, and the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: this is a research framework, and deployment scale, sensors and validation results were not reviewed. It supports digital twin design for wastewater plant operation and lists no linked catalogue records.
